title: Bloom vs Cuckoo
tagline: Compare three probabilistic membership filters by build cost, query latency, and false-positive tradeoffs.

curves.label: Bloom Filter (k hashes)
curves.code: bits= Math.ceil(10*n); k= Math.max(1, Math.floor(Math.log(2)*bits/n)); insert(x){for(i=0;i<k;i++) setbit(hash_i(x)%bits);} query(x){fp=1; for(i=0;i<k;i++) if(!getbit(hash_i(x)%bits)) return false; return true;}
curves.name: Bloom Filter (k hashes)

curves.label: Cuckoo Filter (relocation)
curves.code: cap = 1.3*n; buckets= Math.ceil(cap/4); insert(x){fp = fingerprint(x); i = bucketIndex(hash(x)); for(loop=0; loop<32; loop++){ if(bucket has empty) place(fp); else {victim=chooseSlot(); swap(fp,victim); i = altIndex(i, fp);} } rehash(); } query(x){fp=fingerprint(x); i=bucketIndex(hash(x)); return bucketHas(i,fp) || bucketHas(altIndex(i,fp),fp);}
curves.name: Cuckoo Filter (relocation)

curves.label: Quotient Filter
curves.code: m = 2*Math.ceil(Math.log2(n+1)); q = new Array(m); insert(x){r = hash(x); rem = r % m; qidx = Math.floor(r/m) % m; probe = findRunStart(qidx); shiftRightToMakeSpace(probe); q[probe]= (occupied,rem);} query(x){r=hash(x); qidx= Math.floor(r/m) % m; run = locateRun(qidx); return binarySearchRemInRun(run, r % m);}
curves.name: Quotient Filter

curves.label: Learned Hash Membership
curves.code: train model on samples: model = fit(x -> bucketId); table = buildBuckets(); insert(x){b=model.predict(x); table[b].push(fingerprint(x));} query(x){b=model.predict(x); return table[b] contains fingerprint(x);} note: trainingCost ~ O(n^2/(n+10)).
curves.name: Learned Hash Membership
